result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a curb ramp. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing lacks physical protection like a median or curb extensions on a two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked crosswalk, sidewalks, and ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile paving. While a traffic signal is present, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signals or traffic calming measures to further protect walkers in this residential area.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may lead to conflicts with turning traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: On the signal pole in the foreground

hazards.name: Standard crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The parallel line crosswalk markings have lower visibility compared to high-visibility continental patterns.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way and timing information.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line markings to a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down vehicles making right turns.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row houses, featuring a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps with tactile warnings is present, the wide roadway and lack of traffic calming or signals create potential risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the crosswalk may obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the row houses.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The roadway is relatively wide with no median or refuge island, increasing pedestrian exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the marked crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures or a median refuge may expose pedestrians to higher vehicle speeds during the crossing.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
